title: Design Day Bangalore — Art in Design
description:
The theme for APRIL's 2015's Design Day is:

"ART IN DESIGN"

The agenda includes:

1. The interaction will strive to explore some elements of Indian miniature paintings, in the language of 20th century design. We hope to experience the joy of unraveling our art heritage from the perspective of design, draw parallels with contemporary work, draw inspiration, and may be, literally, just draw. Some ragamala, brahmasa and narrative paintings might be covered as part of the interaction.

The theme forms a part of of doctoral research pursued by Nimish.

3. A JAM: You will be given a topic and would have to come up with some design suggestions based on that topic in 2 hours. This is a group activity, where participants are split into groups of 4-5 people. We will have markers, sketchpens and chart papers for your use.

Cheers,

Aashish/Amit
